p.i: Quàm, blanda te fallit voluptas! Quò domiuum[?] violenta torquet. Namque illa tetris vt semel, heu! tibi Mentem tenebris obruit, inquies Te versat æstus, teq; nigro Perdit atrox Phlegethonte mersum. Sic dira nauem quum violentia Stridentis Euri, vel Boreæ impetus Iactat procellosum per æquor, (Ludibrium resonantis vndæ) Allisa tandem rupibus asperis, Ruptisque velis, remigio & latus Nudata quassatum fatiscit, Atque petit maris ima sæui.

main_text.head: XXIIII. GAL.
main_text.p: QVAND le iour fils du soleil Nous descouure à son reueil La montagne couloree: D'vne lumiere doree: Ie remets en ma pensee Le beau iour d'Eternité, Quand la nuict sera passee, Et ce Monde aura esté.
main_text.head: LAT.

page.notes: No marginal notes are printed; faint show-through from the other side appears in both margins and was left out. Catchword "Reddit" is printed in italic at the right.
